content.text: I go to school on foot.

content.text: I often play football.

We fly kites in spring.

content.text: I watch TV on Saturdays.

Module 1.unit: Unit 1 I went to Sanya for my holidays.

content.text: I went to Sanya for my holidays.
Did you have a good time?
Yes, I did. I swam in the sea.
content.translation: 是的，我很开心。我在海里游泳了。

content.text: Sounds great!
Where did you go last weekend?
I went to Beijing with my family.
How did you go there?
We went by plane.
This is my grandmother. She is very kind.
content.translation: 这是我奶奶。她非常慈祥。

content.text: Is this your grandfather? He's so tall!
content.translation: 这是你爷爷吗？他好高啊！

content.text: Yes. He tells me stories every night.
content.translation: 是的。他每天晚上给我讲故事。

content.text: My weekend was great! I visited the Great Wall.
content.translation: 我周末很棒！我去游览了长城。

content.text: Wow! I want to visit it too.

Module 4.unit: Unit 1 I got a letter from my pen pal.

content.text: I got a letter from my pen pal in London.
content.translation: 我收到了伦敦笔友的来信。

content.text: What did she say?
She visited the Tower Bridge last week.
Welcome to our school! It's very beautiful.
content.translation: 欢迎来到我们的学校！它非常漂亮。

content.text: We love our school!

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 We wish you a Merry Christmas!

content.text: We wish you a Merry Christmas!
Merry Christmas, everyone!

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 I'll send you a postcard.

content.text: I'll send you a postcard from Shanghai.
content.translation: 我会从上海寄一张明信片给你。

content.text: That's a great idea!

Module 8.unit: Unit 1 The Pandas are in danger.

content.text: Pandas are in danger. We must protect them.
content.translation: 熊猫正处于危险之中。我们必须保护它们。

content.text: I'll try my best to help them.
I was happy yesterday because it was my birthday.
content.translation: 我昨天很开心，因为昨天是我的生日。

content.text: Happy birthday, Amy!

content.text: I'm in New York now. The city is very big.
content.translation: 我现在在纽约。这座城市非常大。

content.text: What's the weather like?
It's sunny but cold.
I helped Mum cook dinner yesterday.
content.translation: 我昨天帮妈妈做了晚饭。

content.text: That's a good boy!
I made a cake for my mum's birthday.
content.translation: 我给妈妈的生日做了一个蛋糕。

content.text: Was it delicious?

content.text: I helped the old man cross the road yesterday.
content.translation: 我昨天帮助那位老人过了马路。

content.text: He is very clever. He can solve hard problems.
content.translation: 他非常聪明。他能解决难题。

content.text: The world is beautiful. We should protect it.

content.text: There were twenty yesterday.
Where is the missing one?

content.text: There are lots of trees on the hill.
There is a river near the hill too.
It's a beautiful place.

content.translation: 昨天下午我们买了冰淇淋。

content.text: What flavour did you buy?
Strawberry and chocolate.

content.text: My father was a fisherman ten years ago.

content.text: What does he do now?
He is a cook now.

Module 4.unit: Unit 1 We didn't see the Pandas.

content.text: We didn't see the Pandas at the zoo last Sunday.

content.text: That's too bad!

Module 5.unit: Unit 1 Dad always puts the rubbish in the bin.

content.text: Dad always puts the rubbish in the bin.
content.translation: 爸爸总是把垃圾放进垃圾桶里。

content.text: We should do the same!

Module 6.unit: Unit 1 I am reading a newspaper.

content.text: What are you doing, Lingling?

Module 7.unit: Unit 1 There are five people in my family.

content.text: There are five people in my family.
Who are they?
My grandparents, my parents and me.
content.translation: 我爷爷奶奶、爸爸妈妈和我。

content.text: What are you doing, Mum?
I'm making a cake for your birthday.
content.translation: 我在为你的生日做一个蛋糕。

content.text: Are you feeling sad, Daming?
No, I'm feeling excited! Tomorrow is the sports day.
content.translation: 不，我感到兴奋！明天是运动会。

content.text: Please be quiet. I'm watching TV.
OK. Sorry.

Module 1.unit: Unit 1 He is playing the piano.

content.text: Listen! He is playing the piano beautifully.
content.translation: 听！他正在优美地弹钢琴。

content.text: We had a good time at the picnic!
content.translation: 我们在野餐中玩得很开心！

content.text: I'll send you a card from London.
content.translation: 我会从伦敦给你寄一张卡片。
